summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release reporting new residential construction statistics for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 1a provides seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) data for privately-owned building permits, specifically broken down into "1 unit" (single-family) and "5 units or more" categories. The table lists monthly permit levels from August 2021 through August 2022, including the August 2022 values (899,000 for single-family; 571,000 for 5+ units) and the month-over-month percentage change from July 2022 (-3.5% for single-family; -18.5% for 5+ units). This document contributes the initial data point for the August 2022 start of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe but does not contain the subsequent monthly data required to calculate the average absolute volatility for the full period.
